div.head: Leis Wl 42.2
div.ab: E en Denelae qui dreit jugement refuserad, seit en la merci de sa laxlite.
In Danelahe qui rectum iudicium subire contempserit, erit in forisfactura de suo laslite.
E en Denelae, qui dreit jugement refuserad seit en la merci de sa laxlite.
42, 2. Und im Dänen-Rechtsgebiet wer gesetzliches Urtheil zurückweist, sei in der ‘Gnade’ [des Gerichtsherrn, d. h. Strafgeldschuld] in Höhe seiner Rechtsbruchbusse.

42, 2. And in the Danish legal district, whoever rejects lawful judgement shall be in the ‘mercy’ [of the lord of the court, i.e. liable to a money penalty] to the amount of his compensation for breach of law.
And he who in the Danelaw refuses just judgment shall forfeit a fine equal to his lahslit.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 272–273 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 517, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
